verdict.rationale: Qodo's docs describe org-wide code governance features — a centralized rule system, cross-repo/service impact mapping, and 'a complete history of findings, decisions, and codebase health' (qodo-docs-14, qodo-docs-15) plus org-level policy settings (qodo-docs-10) and PR risk tagging (qodo-docs-8) — which supports an engineering-lead-facing oversight view. However, no evidence explicitly describes a dashboard UI, or metrics like 'acceptance rate' or 'review coverage %' as named reporting artifacts. Missing for 10: explicit dashboard/reporting UI screenshots or docs, named acceptance-rate metric, named review-coverage metric, independent confirmation of these views in practice.
